title: Talked to a super agent-pilled founder. He bought Codex Max for all team members, and everybody pretty much gets all work done thru talking to their Codex all day The side effect: people stopped talking to each other. Meetings are cancelled, collaboration is minimal, and team culture got worse So much of enterprise AI usage is single-player now. What do we risk sacrificing when team members all talk to their agents instead of each other? We need to move beyond human-human collaboration AND beyond human-agent collaboration to human-human-agent collaboration
